text:
ron: saw a brief window where keystore audit lines for onprem-chi were missing, ops alerted by retention monitor :warning:
ops-bot: retention-monitor: missing-audit=60s; tenant=acme; cluster=onprem-chi
clare: which jobs were running? any rolling restarts scheduled?
shiv: CI had a rollout at 02:12, migration job kicked at 02:10. I see `vault-unseal` timeouts between 02:09-02:13 in migration logs.
net-eng: we had a micro BGP flap in that time, brief path reroute.
clare: suspicious pattern: breakglass token tb-lite used at 02:11 three times. need to check RBAC drift.
shiv: pulling vault audit snippet:
```
2026-04-05T02:11:05Z method=wrap path=/v1/transit/keys/acme action=wrap auth.token_id=tb-lite role=keystore-breakglass auth.method=token
```
clare: breakglass role should require MFA and sourceCIDR; migration might not have applied to these nodes.
ops-bot: snapshot started: collect /var/log/vault/audit.log, iptables, netpols from affected nodes.
ron: immediate actions: 1) revoke tb-lite 2) rotate any tokens with TTL>24h in infra namespace 3) apply RBAC canary requiring auth.method=mfa and source_ip=10.60.0.0/24 to one pod 4) increase audit retention for tenant acme by 30d.
shiv: revoking tb-lite now. creating a short-lived ops token for emergency use TTL=1h.
clare: net-eng can we open ephemeral egress from migration pod to vault-unseal CIDR for 10m so migration can complete? we need to avoid repeated failures mid-rollout.
net-eng: will apply a canary netpol to node chi-canary-01 for 15m. will monitor for traffic leakage.
audit-bot: create alert: vault_breakglass_usage > 2 in 5m -> paged to eng-security. rule created.
ron: follow-ups: add migration heartbeat metric, make migration idempotent with pre/post policy hash checks, and require CI gate to abort rolling restarts if heartbeat missing.
clare: opening a short postmortem doc and assigning owners. Closing thread once canary RBAC proves stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
